limits: Original end-to-end rows and thresholds are unchanged; no timing subtraction, excluded outliers or additive p95 calculation.
Node command spans include Playwright transport and scheduling/actionability. They do not isolate product functions.

Expected-DOM is sampled by a driver-triggered evaluate after its locator wait; its browser-clock interval also includes intervening driver/transport waits and is not autonomous React-commit or physical-paint timing.
Resource entries are browser-observed timing and are associated by clock overlap only. Route categories lack exact project identity; overlap is not causality or exclusive request-to-action mapping.
Primary slow actions were not traced. The trace is the separately instrumented 32-action follow-up, which must not explain earlier failures by inference.
No CPU profile or weighted CPU attribution is used. No allocation, workload throughput, live-model or Windows claim.
